verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents free and paid trial periods through its Trial Offer API, including limited-duration discounted introductory rates, and says it handles trial billing periods. Nothing in the evidence covers coupons, promotion codes, explicit trial-to-paid conversion, or card-network-compliant trial-end notifications. Missing for 10: coupon and promotion code support, documented automatic trial-to-paid conversion, trial-end reminder notifications meeting card-network rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run free trials, coupons, and promotion codes with automatic conversion to paid — including trial-end notifications required by card-network rules

citations.quote: Use the Trial Offer API to manage both free and paid introductory periods for your subscriptions with a single API integration.
Trial offers enable you to qualify high-intent leads, reduce trial abuse, and provide discounted rates to your customers for a limited duration
handles billing periods, such as trials and renewals
